q2_gaps: non-finite temporal adjunct "before V-ing" — the instruction set says only that "before" + an event/clause takes the `Before` relation, and separately that an event-noun anchor and a non-finite embedded eventuality take no tense of their own; it never settles whether a gerund adjunct clause is asserted at top level and may carry `(Past ...)`
notes: Everything else checks out: unantecedented "he" gets a typed `person` witness, "for three years" is a duration `Measure`, comitative "with his family" is `CoAgent`, the possessive is `Possession`, and "move back" is kept whole as a particle verb with no genus.
